services.desc: The Ohio Afterschool Child Enrichment (ACE) Educational Savings Account program provides funds to a student’s parent or guardian to use on various enrichment and educational activities. The program is being offered through a contract between Merit International, Inc. and the Ohio Department of Education. U.S. Moo Do Academy is proud to function as a Qualified Service Provider for this program. U.S. Moo Do Academy’s martial arts programs benefit children with confidence, discipline, self-control, mobility, physical growth, and more.
